newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai state power firm to issue 4-bln baht bonds.
newsitem.headline: Thai state power firm to issue 4-bln baht bonds.

text.p: State-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) will issue four billion baht ($155 million) worth of seven-year bonds, a Thai Farmers Bank official said on Monday.
Thai Farmers Bank on Monday won a bid to underwrite the issues, which will have a fixed coupon rate of 8.924 percent per annum, the official, Somboon Shinsawananond, told Reuters.
"The bonds will be issued on January 30. EGAT has a triple A rating from the Thai Rating Information Service," he said, referring to TRIS, the local credit rating agency.
The proceeds will be use to redeem another batch of EGAT's bonds issued in 1991 worth 3.33 billion baht and in two existing power projects, accroding to an EGAT official.
